diagnosis: The large GEMM kernels have nearly identical runtime; the gap is not less model compute.

Megatron uses its fallback multi-tensor Adam path because Apex/Transformer Engine optimizer extensions are unavailable, while nanoMegatron uses torch fused AdamW. This accounts for roughly 17 ms/step.
Megatron launches about 763 more CUDA kernels per profiled step from generic TP-capable linear wrappers, main-grad scaling/checks, norm/cat/copy pointwise work, and repeated RoPE cos/sin application.
The remaining difference is Python/autograd/launch overhead: Megatron spent 24.7 ms more CPU time in cudaLaunchKernel across three profiled steps.
